commitments.detail: Used oil drums will be disposed of by 2023-10-15.
Batteries will be palletized and labeled for pickup by 2023-10-15.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned by 2023-10-17.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by 2023-10-16 and stored upright.
Used oil drums will be disposed of by the environmental department on 2023-04-15.
Vehicle batteries require proper labeling before pickup by the maintenance department.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to the medical-logistics department by 2023-04-17.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by the transportation department on 2023-04-16.
Used oil drums will be picked up on 2023-10-15.
Vehicle batteries will be palletized and labeled before pickup on 2023-10-16.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned on 2023-10-17.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up on 2023-10-16 without an upright rack.
Used oil drums will be picked up for recycling on 2023-10-15.
Batteries will be palletized and labeled for return to the supply chain by 2023-10-15.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to the medical supply chain on 2023-10-20.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up on 2023-10-18 and must be upright-racked during transport.
